description: Shared guards that turn agent rules into checks: rg over recursive grep, a confirmation for git commit and push outside your own repos, a preview before a git command discards uncommitted changes, a check before a reply hands back unchecked items, no bold or italic in markdown, no attribution in commits or PRs, and no private work terms in your public repos.
name: guards

labOwners.description: GitHub owners of your own repos, separated by spaces or commas. git commit, git push and gh pr create run without asking only in a repo whose origin one of them owns; left empty, they ask everywhere.
labOwners.title: Lab repo owners

privateTerms.description: Words that must never reach your public lab repos, separated by spaces or commas, such as a work ticket prefix, a client name or a work email domain. A Write, Edit, git commit or gh pr text holding one is denied in a lab repo. Left empty, nothing is checked.
privateTerms.title: Private terms
